label: D2 after choosing a2 when the previous trial was unrewarded, early in the episode (strongest on trial 0)
explanation: Fires almost only at D2 (94% of mass; a few weak hits at GO, never at D1) after the agent chose a2 (99% of mass) and the previous trial was unrewarded (97% of mass; never when in_rew=1). It is confined to the first ~50 trials of an episode and silent after trial 55. Magnitude is dominated by the episode first trial: D2 at ep_trial 0 is active 100% of the time and carries 48% of the activation mass, with the window maxima at a2 -> S1 rare on trial 0. Elsewhere activations are small (about 0.01-0.12 of max) and somewhat larger after rare transitions (a2 -> S1). Both reached states fire. The predicate uses only observed variables: the action is known at D2 and prev_reward was the D1 input. ep_trial is not an input, but the agent can track elapsed time. Dev precision is low (0.27) because many early-episode a2/unrewarded D2 steps stay silent, while mass recall is high (0.90). Adding common==0, stay, or value/choice cuts did not improve F1 much.
